text: PART III - LANDS NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO PROPERTY OF INTESTATE REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT NO. 21 OF 1998 (SECTION 55) Reference the intestate property of late Mr. Vidana Kankanamge Sumanasena Amaraweera who resided in the village of Madapatha, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kesbawa, in the District of Colombo. It is hereby notified that any person/s who have a claim to or interest in the intestate property of the late Mr. Vidana Kankanamge Suma-nasena Amaraweera described in the Schedule hereto should submit his/their claim to the undersigned in writing before 05th September 2019 stating his/their right or interest to such intestate property. In case of failure to do so, exparte action will be taken to register title under Section 55 (2) and (3) of the Registration of Title Act. No. 21 of 1998. P. M. H. PRIYADHARSHANI, Commissioner of Title Settlement (Covering up Duties.) Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Madura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla. 22nd July 2019 SCHEDULE Divisional Village Cadastral Parcel No. Extent of Land Certificate Office of Secretary’s Division Map No. of Title No. Registration
(Hectare) Kesbawa Madapatha 521204 Block 06 0.0137 00042535247 Delkanda Parcel No. 173

N.B.- Letters claiming a right to intestate property should mention the Cadastral Map number, parcel number and the entitlement of the claimant to claim such property. The top left-hand corner of the envelope should bear the phrase “Application for Intestate Property.”
(Published by Authority)
